nodes.label: SMMAI Brand Direction
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for all visual decisions; written from user answers plus Zyno inspiration so antislop agents have direction before any UI change.

nodes.label: Emerald-on-Deep-Black Palette
nodes.rationale: Emerald on deep green-cast black creates Zyno-level contrast punch; the green cast is the brand differentiator, avoiding generic blue-midnight SaaS and purple AI-cliche palettes.

nodes.label: Plus Jakarta Sans Typography
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Inter (the AI default) for rounder terminals and a more human, warm-geometric professional feel.

nodes.label: Design Dials (ENERGY/RHYTHM/MOTION)
nodes.rationale: ENERGY 3 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1 declared to keep high-energy bold structure with purposeful-only motion, per antislop dial mechanics.

nodes.label: Approval Gate Identity Motif
nodes.rationale: The approval gate (step 04) gets a distinct visual because it is the product's core value proposition.

nodes.label: R-13 Glow Dose Cap (Brand Instance)
nodes.rationale: Only two glow elements allowed total (hero ambient + arch border glow) to satisfy antislop R-13 while keeping the Zyno-inspired depth.
